export GRADLE_BIN="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; test -x "$GRADLE_BIN"; git fetch origin main agent-control; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; git clean -fd; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/patches/local-speech-pfd-loopback.py > /tmp/local-speech-pfd-loopback.py; python3 /tmp/local-speech-pfd-loopback.py; "$GRADLE_BIN" :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.localspeech.LocalSpeechPcmTest; echo local_speech_pcm_tests_green=true; bash scripts/verify_host.sh; echo host_quality_gate_green=true; git diff --check; git add app/src/main/kotlin/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/DiagnosticProbeActivity.kt app/src/main/kotlin/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/LocalSpeechPfdLoopbackProbe.kt app/src/main/kotlin/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/localspeech/LocalSpeechPcm.kt app/src/test/kotlin/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/localspeech/LocalSpeechPcmTest.kt; git commit -m 'feat: prove local speech PFD loopback'; git push origin HEAD:main; echo pushed_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD); test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; DEVICES=$(adb devices -l || true); PRESENT=$(DEVICES="$DEVICES" PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -c 'import os; from realtime_network_smoke import is_direct_usb_target; print(1 if is_direct_usb_target(os.environ.get("DEVICES", ""), "RFCT70L7E8J") else 0)'); if [ "$PRESENT" != 1 ]; then echo local_speech_direct_usb=false; echo local_speech_pfd_probe_not_run=true; exit 0; fi; echo local_speech_direct_usb=true; CALL_STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); echo local_speech_call_state_before=$CALL_STATE; if [ "$CALL_STATE" != 0 ]; then echo local_speech_idle_call_required=true; echo local_speech_pfd_probe_not_run=true; exit 0; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/local-speech-pfd-install.log; cat /tmp/local-speech-pfd-install.log; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm grant "$PKG" android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO; echo local_speech_record_audio_granted=true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" rm -f files/local-speech-pfd-loopback-report.txt 2>/dev/null || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.DiagnosticProbeActivity" --ez run_local_speech_pfd_loopback_probe true; REPORT=''; for i in $(seq 1 660); do REPORT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" cat files/local-speech-pfd-loopback-report.txt 2>/dev/null | tr -d '' || true); if printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^probe_complete=true$'; then break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; echo '--- local speech PFD loopback report ---'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT"; echo '--- end report ---'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^probe_complete=true$'; CALL_STATE_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); echo local_speech_call_state_after=$CALL_STATE_AFTER; test "$CALL_STATE_AFTER" = 0; if printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^loopback_success=true$'; then echo local_speech_pfd_loopback_green=true; elif printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^model_download_scheduled=true$'; then echo local_speech_model_download_scheduled=true; else echo local_speech_pfd_loopback_not_green=true; fi; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
